name: VanillaVotifier
author: vanillavotifier@users.noreply.github.com
description: Standalone Votifier server for vanilla Minecraft servers.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl

curl --fail --location --silent --show-error --output "/mnt/server/${SERVER_JARFILE}" -- "https://github.com/Redraxed/VanillaVotifier/releases/latest/download/VanillaVotifier.jar"

cat > /mnt/server/config.yaml <<'EOF'
config-version: 4
log-directory: logs
server:
  ip: 0.0.0.0
  port: 8192
key-pair-files:
  public: public.pem
  private: private.pem
on-vote: []
EOF
mkdir -p /mnt/server/logs
echo 'VanillaVotifier has been installed.'

variables.name: Server JAR File
variables.description: Name of the downloaded VanillaVotifier JAR.
